name: Publish
description: Get the link and chat card for one of this workspace's pages, or put a file or folder from elsewhere in the sandbox on the web. This workspace's pages are its /public folder, served as they are at https://…:8447/<this workspace>/ and live as soon as they're written: /public/<name>/index.html is the page /<name>/, and other files are served as they are. With a path outside /public (an HTML file, a chart, a CSV, a folder with its index.html), publish copies it into /public/<slug> first. Pages are static for now: scripts don't run and nothing loads from other hosts, but CSS in <style> or style="" works. With no slug or path it lists this workspace's pages; remove deletes a page from /public.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Put the trip plan on a page I can open on my phone
Take the trip plan page down

path.description: A file or folder to copy into /public/<slug>, e.g. '/work/report' or '/project/chart.png', or a page already in /public, e.g. '/public/trip-plan'.

slug.description: The page's name in its URL: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. 'trip-plan'.

remove.description: Set true to delete the page at slug (or path) from /public, taking it off the web.
